title: Graf Joins Old Second National Bank
summary: CHICAGO, IL / ACCESS Newswire / June 15, 2026 / Old Second National Bank welcomes the addition of Michael Graf as Senior Managing Director and Head of Middle Market Banking. He has more than 30 years of experience serving middle market clients throughout the greater Chicago area. Prior to joining Old Second, Michael spent 14 years at First Midwest Bank/Old National Bank, where he held a series of leadership roles within the Corporate Banking division, most recently serving as Group Head of Middle Market Banking. Earlier in his career, he held multiple lending positions within the Metropolitan Bank Group at LaSalle Bank in Chicago, culminating in his role as Senior Vice President and Team Lead. Michael earned his bachelor's degree from Marquette University and holds an MBA from Loyola University Chicago.
